from pathlib import Path
import json

event_id="1791189331-f009466138a8"
base=Path.home()/".local/share/prediction-chat-bridge"
raw=None
where=None
for d in ("sent","inflight","outbox"):
    p=base/d/f"{event_id}.json"
    if p.is_file():
        obj=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8",errors="replace"))
        raw=str(obj.get("message") or "")
        where=str(p)
        break
if raw is None:
    print("STAGED_PATHS_RAW=EVENT_MISSING")
    raise SystemExit(42)

marker="production staged inspect: "
pos=raw.find(marker)
if pos < 0:
    print("STAGED_PATHS_RAW=MARKER_MISSING || FILE="+where)
    raise SystemExit(42)

tail=raw[pos+len(marker):]
try:
    payload,_=json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(tail)
except Exception as exc:
    print("STAGED_PATHS_RAW=JSON_PARSE_FAIL || ERROR="+str(exc)[:180]+" || FILE="+where)
    raise SystemExit(42)

print(
    "STAGED_PATHS_RAW="
    +"branch="+str(payload.get("branch"))
    +" || staged_n="+str(payload.get("staged_n"))
    +" || different_n="+str(payload.get("different_n"))
    +" || staged="+json.dumps(payload.get("staged_sample"),separators=(",",":"))
    +" || different="+json.dumps(payload.get("different_sample"),separators=(",",":"))
    +" || FILE="+where,
    flush=True,
)
raise SystemExit(42)
